body_md:
The **First World War** (1914–1918) ended at 11 am on 11 November 1918. The Battle of the Somme in 1916 caused huge losses.

In the **Second World War** (1939–1945) Winston Churchill became Prime Minister in 1940. Soldiers were rescued from **Dunkirk**, the RAF won the **Battle of Britain**, and Allied forces landed in Normandy on **D-Day**, 6 June 1944.

After 1945 Clement Attlee's government created the welfare state and the **NHS** in 1948. British inventions of the time include penicillin, the jet engine and radar.
key_facts: 11 November 1918: end of the First World War
1940: Dunkirk and the Battle of Britain
